tools.name: doorman_check_ai_bot_access
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether their site (or any public site) blocks ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Perplexity or other AI crawlers, whether AI can read or train on their content, or why AI search does not mention their site. Fetches the live robots.txt and reports, for 22 named AI bots in four groups

tools.name: doorman_check_robots_txt
tools.description: Use when the user pastes the text of a robots.txt (or you have drafted one) and asks which AI bots it lets in or blocks, or whether a change does what they want. Parses it the way crawlers do (groups, wildcards, longest-match) and reports each of 22 named AI bots as let in, kept out or partly blocke

tools.name: doorman_write_robots_txt
tools.description: Use when the user wants to allow or block AI training, AI search or assistant bots on their site and needs the robots.txt lines. Takes an optional existing robots.txt plus a choice of "in" or "out" for each of three groups (training, ai_search, assistants) and returns a complete robots.txt that keep
